title: Omulanga Omutafaayo mu Nsi ey’Amalala
intro: Oyimiridde mu bifunfugu by’empukuuka eyali ennene, amaanyi n’amalala gye byali tebimanyi kkomo. Omubaka yatambula mu bo, ng’akoowoola amazima, naye emitima gyabwe ne gikakanyavu. Okulabula okwo tekwafaayo, era eggulu lyenyini ne lifuuka ekintu eky’obusungu. Omubaka ono yali ani, era kiki ekyatuuka ku abo abaagaana omulanga?
clues: Nasindikibwa mu bantu abaali tebalina kye bafaanana mu maanyi era nga ku buli kifo ekigulumivu bazimba ekijjukizo.
Abantu bange beetwalanga nga tebawangulwa ne bagamba nti, ‘Ani atusinga amaanyi mu maanyi?’.
Nabayita okusinza Allah yekka, naye ne banvunaana obusirusiru n’obulimba.
Bansomooza okuleeta ekibonerezo kye nnasuubiza bwe mba nga ndi wa mazima.
Allah yabasindika empewo etaliimu bimera nga teyasonyiwa kintu kyonna kye yatuukako.
Nze n’abo abakkiriza nange twalokoka olw’okusaasira kwa Allah, ate abatakkiriza ne bazikirizibwa ddala.

outcome.label: Ebivudemu
options: Hudi n’abakkiriza ne balokolebwa, n’abatakkiriza ne bazikirizibwa
Hud yasitulwa n’atwalibwa ku siteegi eya waggulu
Abantu ba Hudi beenenya era ne bawona
Hud yaleka abantu be nga tannaweebwa kibonerezo kyonna
outcome.answer: Hudi n’abakkiriza ne balokolebwa, n’abatakkiriza ne bazikirizibwa

arabic: فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍۢ مِّنَّا وَقَطَعْنَا دَابِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا ۖ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
verse: So We saved him and those with him by mercy from Us. And We eliminated those who denied Our signs, and they were not [at all] believers. (7:72)
